task.title: Cancel provider-tool task turns
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/580 by retaining a caller-owned cancellation reason across bounded provider/tool task turns and explicitly recording cancellation without claiming to interrupt in-flight work.
acceptance_criteria: Expose cancellation-specific initial and continuation operations that retain the validated caller reason.
Keep tool responses non-terminal and require explicit caller progression with fresh identity and authorization.
On a final response, persist assistant content and an exact Attempt before cancelling the task with the original reason.
Document that this terminal boundary records a decision and does not provide cooperative interruption of provider or tool work.

attempts.summary: Established RED for initial and continued cancellation turns.
attempts.diagnostic: ToolAssistantRuntime lacked cancellation-specific outcomes, operations, and a continuation capable of preserving caller-owned cancellation intent.
attempts.patch: Added focused failing tests for direct final cancellation and cancellation after an explicit tool continuation.

attempts.diagnostic: Cancellation-specific outcomes retain the caller reason while reusing the bounded attempt-only provider/tool path; finalization records provider text as Attempt evidence before cancelling the task.
attempts.patch: Added cancellation outcomes and continuations, initial and continuation methods, durable projection tests, documentation, and milestone status.

attempts.summary: Refactored around the established symmetric terminal boundary.
attempts.diagnostic: Completion and failure already established a small terminal-finalization pattern, so cancellation required no new loop, retry, permission, or storage mechanism.
attempts.patch: Kept dispatch and continuation logic shared, isolated only cancellation intent and final state application, and documented the non-interrupting contract.

attempts.summary: Verified exact head and merged after the review cooldown.
attempts.diagnostic: Pinned just verify and independent review passed. Rust quality gate run 30152645001 succeeded. The initial CodeRabbit status was a false-green rate limit; after cooldown, one deliberate exact-head review completed with no actionable findings and zero review threads.
attempts.patch: Pull request 581 squash-merged as c2be9c3fe3cd23f398c973bbd46131e281760edc and closed issue 580.

outcome.summary: Provider-tool task turns can now retain caller-owned cancellation intent across explicit tool steps and durably record cancellation after final Attempt evidence without implying in-flight interruption.

verification.command: nix develop --command cargo test --locked -p vela-kernel --test tool_task_runtime cancellation_
Independent pre-commit review # no blocking findings
GitHub Rust quality gate https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/actions/runs/30152645001 and substantive CodeRabbit review at https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/pull/581

lessons: A cancellation state transition and cooperative interruption are separate capabilities; documentation must not conflate them.
Caller-owned cancellation reasons belong in typed continuations while provider output remains Attempt evidence.
Symmetric terminal orchestration can stay simple by reusing one bounded runtime path and varying only retained intent and finalization.
When a review status is rate limited, preserve exact head and resume once after cooldown rather than racing auto-merge.
